parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to obtain the value.

parameters.name: ScriptContent
parameters.description:
The script content. This parameter cannot be empty.

For more information about script examples, see [What is data parsing](~~68702~~).

parameters.name: ScriptType
parameters.description:
The script type. Valid values:

- JavaScript
- Python_27: Python 2.7
- PHP_72: PHP 7.2
